mapping_rules.corpus: copy frozen chunks and documents as JSON values; no rechunking or text normalization
mapping_rules.no_answer: no_answer = not V3 answerable, requiring an explicit boolean
mapping_rules.provenance: bind every canonical file to source package/QREL hashes, adapter version/SHA, source and destination schema versions
mapping_rules.qrels: frozen V3 qrels array; retain original row fields and query text byte values; add explicit no_answer and canonical target aliases
mapping_rules.review: retain only review-approved or corrected final QRELs; require rejected candidate excluded and zero pending reviews
mapping_rules.targets: acceptable_targets preserved in order; expected_chunk_id -> chunk_id and expected_document_id -> benchmark_document_id; primary and legitimate alternates unchanged
